description: Intron (Intron Health, Inc.), founded by Tobi Olatunji with teams in Lagos, Abuja, Accra and Nairobi, builds the Sahara speech recognition and text-to-speech models for African accents and languages. Its Voice API offers file and streaming transcription in 60+ languages (with code-switched recognition for 12 African languages mixed with English), clinical and call-centre post-processing, and TTS in 13 African languages and African-accented English. Usage is billed against a credit balance on the voice.intron.io platform.
name: Intron Health
